welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.body: Hey {name}, welcome to the team. I am {sponsor}, your sponsor. If you would like, we can go through your first steps together. You are not alone.

congratulations.title: Congratulations
congratulations.body: Hey {name}, a quick note: You did a great job. This kind of consistency builds real leadership. Keep going — I see the work you are putting in.

reminder.title: Reminder
reminder.body: Hey {name}, just a quick reminder about our next step. If things are tight right now, let me know — we will find a realistic way forward.

reactivation.title: Reactivation
reactivation.body: Hey {name}, I noticed things have been quiet for a while. No pressure — I just wanted to ask how you are and whether there is anything I can help take off your plate.

follow_up.title: Follow-up
follow_up.body: Hey {name}, a quick follow-up on our last conversation. Do you still have questions, or should we make the next step concrete?

onboarding.title: Onboarding
onboarding.body:
Hey {name}, here is your onboarding — the final activation step after registration:
http://waytomoon.netlify.app

It covers the business basics, compensation, first steps, team expectations, and access to the exchange group and Nina information group. If you get stuck, contact me directly.

zoom_invitation.title: Zoom Invitation
zoom_invitation.body: Hey {name}, I would like to invite you to a short Zoom call. The goal is clarity, not a marathon of slides. Would this evening or tomorrow suit you better?

birthday.title: Birthday
birthday.body: Hey {name}, happy birthday. It is great to have you on the team — I am looking forward to the next stage with you.

qualification.title: Qualification
qualification.body: Hey {name}, you are close to the next qualification. Let us quickly review what is still missing and how to complete it properly.

recognition.title: Recognition
recognition.body: Hey {name}, I want to recognize you for a moment: Your attitude and activity stand out. That is leadership in practice.
